note: Real export shipments are confirmed by dated customs/B-L records: water meters (HS 90282000) shipped from India to Bhutan (Phuntsholing, via LCS Jaigaon) and Nepal (Birgunj, via Raxaul) between 2025-07-24 and 2025-12-31, with bill-of-lading numbers quoted above. Declared HS 902610 differs from the actual recorded HS 90282000 (water meters) — per project rule 3 this is not a rejection ground; the company stays in the base and the code should be corrected to the factual 90282000 (verdict accepted_hs_corrected). Industry label 'IT и электроника' is also inaccurate: the actual product is water meters / sanitation metering equipment. Domestic (intra-India) supply evidence could not be established: GST turnover band, GeM/CPPP tenders and contracts are not public in the sources reachable here — web_search returned no results (searx connection refused) and Bing/Google returned only generic 'Everest' noise or HTTP 429, and volza.com returned HTTP 403. Therefore domestic_status = unknown, not 'none_found': absence was not verified, it was simply not retrievable. Revenue and export volume figures: null — not public in the free view, not estimated.
